consistency_rules: keep the same face and hairstyle across scenes
keep outfit design and color identity consistent unless the story explicitly changes them
keep age impression, body proportions, and character identity stable
do not introduce additional protagonists unless the lyrics or scene require them

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in rainy alley, quiet bus stop, window overlooking the city; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with rain blue, slate gray, soft lavender, warm amber; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by close-up raindrops, street-level reflection shot, slow-motion umbrella shot; clear subject separation and intentional negative space

camera_guidance.principle: vary shot scale and viewpoint to support the scene; avoid repeating identical framing in consecutive scenes
